delete.summary: Moves a database to the seven-day deleted state
delete.description:
The database is unreachable and is listed under deleted-databases for at least seven days. Restore it there by immutable ID until permanent purge is authorized. Data, backups and keys are retained until then; storage remains counted against the organization quota until purge. Permanent cleanup begins after that deadline or an explicit DELETE of the deleted-database resource. A call outside placement returns 421 wrong_region; a move in progress or deletion outside the home region returns 409. Other regions drop their copies at deletion and are re-seeded after restore. Branches are independent. Platform databases are protected. Authorization: Bearer <ts-auth project access token>. project_id must equal {project}; scope must grant the operation. {database} is the immutable database ULID or its name. A token narrowed to one database cannot reach another. Tokens for another project or database answer 404.

Required JWT scopes: databases:write.

parameters.name: X-TerraScale-Region-Pin
parameters.description: Optional single raw region ID. An empty, duplicate or malformed pin returns 421 invalid_region_pin and a pin naming another region 421 region_pin_mismatch, both before execution and with recovery guidance; behind the edge a mismatched pin also answers ts-replay: region=<pin>.

delete.summary: Deletes a database only if its immutable identity matches
delete.description:
expectedId must be a canonical uppercase ULID matching the database ID resolved from the name for this request. A mismatch answers 409 database_identity_mismatch before deletion. A matching deletion enters the seven-day deleted state. Data, backups and keys are retained until purgeAt and storage counts against the organization quota until purge. Restore or permanently purge by immutable ID through deleted-databases. Outside placement returns 421 wrong_region; a move in progress returns 409 move_in_progress and deletion outside the home region returns 409 wrong_region. Other regions drop their copies at deletion and are re-seeded after restore. Branches remain independent. Authorization: Bearer <ts-auth project access token>. project_id must equal {project}; scope must grant the operation. {database} is the immutable database ULID or its name. A token narrowed to one database cannot reach another. Tokens for another project or database answer 404.

Required JWT scopes: databases:write.

parameters.description: The immutable database ID inspected by the caller; a canonical uppercase ULID.

get.summary: Lists databases in the seven-day deleted state
get.description:
Requires a project token without a database restriction. Each deleted item includes deletedAt and purgeAt. Data, backups and keys are retained until purgeAt unless explicitly purged or the project or account is deleted. Retained storage counts against the organization quota until purge. Call the region that accepted deletion. Query: after (exclusive cursor from the previous page's next), limit (1 to 100, default 20). Items are in creation order.

Required JWT scopes: databases:read.

post.summary: Restores a deleted database before its seven-day deadline
post.description:
Requires a project token without a database restriction. Deleted databases retain their data and backups until purgeAt. Restore by immutable ID in the region that accepted deletion; a reused name, exhausted database allowance, exceeded organization storage quota, or existing permanent purge returns 409. Retained storage counts against the quota until purge. Other regions are re-seeded after restore. Restoration clears the previous TTL.

Required JWT scopes: databases:write.

get.summary: Reads the durable database purge job
get.description:
Requires a project token without a database restriction and databases:write. Call the region that accepted deletion. Returns 200 with the durable purge job, including after completion. The job remains destroying until files, keys on every holder and backup objects are verified absent, then becomes complete with no outstanding work. Returns 404 when no purge job exists, 409 wrong_region outside the home region, or retryable 503 when unavailable. Reading the job does not start deletion.

Required JWT scopes: databases:write.

delete.summary: Permanently purges a deleted database and releases its storage
delete.description:
Requires a project token without a database restriction and databases:write, the same scope as restore. Call the region that accepted deletion. Starts durable destruction, ending the restore window. 202 includes the job state until files, keys on every holder and backup objects are verified absent; 204 confirms verified completion. Repeating an incomplete request returns its current job; a completed job returns 404 gone on a later DELETE. GET on this path reads the job, including after completion. Storage is released at purge, not at soft deletion. A call outside the home region returns 409 wrong_region.

Required JWT scopes: databases:write.
